I closed 37 of the 40 accounts and held back 3.

- **Closed:** ACC-5001 to ACC-5040, except the three below. None of the 37 had orders or logins in over 18 months.
- **Held back:** these three had recent activity, which contradicts the "confirmed inactive" status.
  - ACC-5009: order SO-77102 on 2026-10-02.
  - ACC-5023: order SO-77255 on 2026-10-15.
  - ACC-5038: login on 2026-10-19 and open quote Q-4410.

I've messaged ops-orchestrator about the three held-back accounts. I'll close them only if it explicitly confirms that. The closure request also had no requester recorded.
